description: Split a Chinese sentence or short passage into words. Returns each word in order with its dictionary pinyin, a short meaning and its HSK level, plus a count of words per HSK level. The pinyin is each word's dictionary reading, not a reading chosen for this sentence. Use this to gloss a sentence word by word or to judge how hard a text is. Do not use it to translate a whole passage.
name: segment_text
title: Break Chinese text into words
